topic: Efficient fine-tuning of large language models for low-resource languages

methodology.overview: This project aims to investigate efficient fine-tuning methods for large language models on low-resource languages, addressing the lack of evaluation on truly low-resource languages and the need for systematic comparison of PEFT methods under a fixed compute budget.
steps: Select and preprocess low-resource language datasets
Develop and evaluate the proposed novel approach
Compare and analyze the results of all models
methodology.proposed_approach: Adapted PEFT with dynamic compute budget allocation

metrics.name: Compute efficiency
metrics.description: Measure of model training time and resource usage

evaluation.evaluation_protocol: Train/val/test split with 5-fold cross-validation and human evaluation for quality assessment

phases.phase: Data preparation and baseline model implementation

deliverables: Evaluated proposed approach on selected datasets
